_comment: Task groups, in run order: 1 Build -> 2 Perception server (DINO+MobileSAM) -> 3 Arm -> 4 Grasp -> 5 Calibrate -> 6 Debug -> 7 Handover (D435i -> person). Real-robot runs need the ranger-garden-assistant bringup running (see README).

tasks.label: 1. Build: Workspace
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && colcon build --symlink-install

tasks.label: 2. Build: DINO + MobileSAM docker image (Jetson)
tasks.command: sudo -n docker build --network host -t grounding-dino:jp6 -f ${workspaceFolder}/deployment/docker/Dockerfile.grounding_dino ${workspaceFolder}/deployment/docker

tasks.label: 2. Server: Start DINO + MobileSAM (local docker)
tasks.command: sudo -n docker rm -f dino_server 2>/dev/null; sudo -n docker run -d --name dino_server --restart unless-stopped --runtime nvidia --network host --ipc host --dns 8.8.8.8 -v ${workspaceFolder}:/workspace/app -v ${env:HOME}/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface -e PYTHONPATH=/workspace/app/src/manipulation_detection -e GROUNDING_DINO_MODEL_ID=IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny -w /workspace/app grounding-dino:jp6 python3 -m manipulation_detection.detection_server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30543; echo 'Server starting (DINO+SAM load on first request ~2min). Health:'; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s http://localhost:30543/health 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done; echo

tasks.label: 2. Server: Stop DINO + MobileSAM
tasks.command: sudo -n docker rm -f dino_server 2>/dev/null; echo 'dino_server stopped'

tasks.label: 2. Server: Health check
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:30543/health; echo

tasks.label: 3. Arm: Enable Piper
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && source ${env:HOME}/codes/ranger-garden-assistant/install/setup.bash && ros2 service call /enable_srv piper_msgs/srv/Enable '{enable_request: true}'

tasks.label: 3. Arm: Set speed (%)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && source ${env:HOME}/codes/ranger-garden-assistant/install/setup.bash && ros2 param set /piper_follow_joint_trajectory_bridge default_speed ${input:armSpeed}

tasks.label: 3. Arm: Move to capture pose (look-down)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /piper_arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory control_msgs/action/FollowJointTrajectory '{trajectory: {joint_names: [piper_joint1, piper_joint2, piper_joint3, piper_joint4, piper_joint5, piper_joint6], points: [{positions: [0.0, 1.2, -0.2, 0.0, -0.35, 0.0], time_from_start: {sec: 6, nanosec: 0}}]}}'

tasks.label: 3. Arm: Home pose / zeros (skill)
tasks._comment: Calls the 'arm_home_pose' skill over /execute_skill -> first lifts the wrist up so the EEF clears the Mid-360 LiDAR, then folds to the zero pose (all joints 0). Needs /skill_server up (start the grasp pipeline, task '4. Grasp: Run pipeline'). Tune the lift waypoint live: ros2 param set /skill_server home_lift_pose '[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0,-0.8,0.0]' (NEGATIVE joint5 = wrist up on this arm; all zeros disables the lift). Override the fold duration with params_json '{"time_sec": 8}'.
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /execute_skill manipulation_msgs/action/ExecuteSkill "{skill: 'arm_home_pose', params_json: '{}'}" --feedback

tasks.label: 3. Arm: Ready pose / look-down (skill)
tasks._comment: Calls the 'arm_ready_pose' skill over /execute_skill -> raises the arm to the look-down capture pose (reads capture_pose, kept in sync with pick). Needs /skill_server up (start the grasp pipeline, task '4. Grasp: Run pipeline').
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /execute_skill manipulation_msgs/action/ExecuteSkill "{skill: 'arm_ready_pose', params_json: '{}'}" --feedback

tasks.label: 4. Grasp: Run pipeline (visual servo + move_group)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 launch manipulation_bringup core_launch.py control_mode:=visual_servo arm_execution_mode:=move_group

tasks.label: 4. Grasp: Set detection prompt (e.g. bottle / bread)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic pub --once /visual_servo/target_prompt std_msgs/msg/String '{data: "${input:graspPrompt}"}'

tasks.label: 4. Grasp: Send pick skill (object)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /execute_skill manipulation_msgs/action/ExecuteSkill "{skill: 'pick', params_json: '{\"object\": \"${input:pickObject}\"}'}" --feedback

tasks.label: 4. Grasp: Send pick&place (object → destination)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /execute_skill manipulation_msgs/action/ExecuteSkill "{skill: 'pick_and_place', params_json: '{\"object\": \"${input:pickObject}\", \"destination\": \"${input:placeDestination}\"}'}" --feedback

tasks.label: 4. Grasp: Run autotune (autonomous)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && source ${env:HOME}/codes/ranger-garden-assistant/install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/grasp_autotune.py

tasks.label: 5. Calibrate: Hand-eye (look-at orbit)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && source ${env:HOME}/codes/ranger-garden-assistant/install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/handeye_orbit_calibrate.py

tasks.label: 4. Detection: Toggle CLIP re-rank
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 param set /remote_detection_client clip_rerank ${input:clipRerank}

tasks.label: 6. Debug: Echo visual-servo state
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /visual_servo/state

tasks.label: 6. Debug: Echo target detections
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo /manipulation/target_detections

tasks.label: 6. Debug: Target detection rate (hz)
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic hz /manipulation/target_detections

tasks.label: 7. Handover: Dry-run sensing (no arm motion, calibrate)
tasks._comment: Grabs ONE D435i frame, detects a person, prints azimuth/distance/joint1 + gate verdict, saves an annotated image. No ROS/arm needed. Tune handover_camera_yaw_rad (azimuth->0) and handover_camera_roll_rad (distance->tape) in config/handover_params.yaml.
tasks.command: env -u PYTHONNOUSERSITE python3 ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/handover_dryrun.py --out /tmp/handover_dryrun.jpg

tasks.label: 7. Handover: Send handover skill (give object to person)
tasks._comment: Run after the grasp pipeline (task '4. Grasp: Run pipeline') so /skill_server is up. Detects the person via D435i, presents the held object at a safe distance, opens the gripper. Requires a held object unless require-object is toggled off. posture: auto (height from the camera), or standing/seated to force the present height.
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 ros2 action send_goal /execute_skill manipulation_msgs/action/ExecuteSkill "{skill: 'handover', params_json: '{\"dwell_sec\": ${input:handoverDwell}, \"posture\": \"${input:handoverPosture}\"}'}" --feedback

tasks.label: 7. Handover: Toggle require-object (test without an object)
tasks._comment: Set false to hand over with an empty gripper (testing). Resets to the config default (true) when skill_server restarts.
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 param set /skill_server handover_require_object ${input:requireObject}

tasks.label: 7. Handover: Echo arm joints (teach present_pose)
tasks._comment: Hand-guide the arm to a good forward-reach presenting posture (at joint1=0), read piper_joint1..6 here, and paste into handover_present_pose in config/handover_params.yaml.
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 topic echo --once /joint_states

inputs.description: Open-vocab object to detect + grasp (Grounding DINO prompt)
Object for the pick skill (/execute_skill). Use a label the detector matches, e.g. 'yellow banana', 'banana', 'bread'
Destination for the pick_and_place skill (localized first, camera clear), e.g. 'white box', 'box', 'plate'
PiPER arm speed percent (1-100); lower = slower/smoother
CLIP re-rank disambiguation: true = CLIP picks the object, false = DINO-only (highest score)
Handover dwell seconds: how long to hold the object out before opening the gripper
Handover require-object gate: true = must be holding something, false = allow empty-gripper test
Recipient posture -> present height: auto (from camera height), or force standing/seated
